description: Open an order and get a Stripe checkout link for the user to pay. Call it only after the user has chosen a plan, agreed to buy, and given the email address for the order (the order link and receipt go there). Nothing is charged by this call: the user opens checkout_url and pays on Stripe. Pass preview_id from draft_listing, or product_url to draft the listing in the same call.

product_url.description: The product website, when there is no preview_id.
